title: Production of Crude AAV Virus Extract
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Production of Crude AAV Virus Extract
DMEM with high glucose, L-glutamine and sodium pyruvate (Thermo Fisher Scientific 11995-065 or equivalent).
OptiMEM I Reduced Serum Medium, GlutaMAX (Thermo Fisher Scientific 51985-034 or equivalent).
TrypLE Select (Thermo Fisher Scientific 12563-011 or equivalent)
Gilson P1000, P20, P200, P10 single channel pipettes
Disposable cell scraper (Fisher Scientific 08-100-242 or equivalent)
Culture dish, 150 mm (VWR SC25383-103 or equivalent)
Fluorescence inverted microscope (Carl Zeiss, Olympus, or equivalent)
Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Units, 100 KDa (Sigma UFC910024)
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
7.3.4 Aliquot and store the solution at -20ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Culture Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the required DMEM media for cell maintenance and transfection.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DMEM with 10% FBS and 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic by adding 50 mL of FBS and 5 mL of Antibiotic-Antimycotic to 500 mL of DMEM; store at 4ºC.
Prepare DMEM with 1% FBS and 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic.

steps.title: Prepare PEI Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sterile PEI solution for transfection.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1 mg of PEI (Polysciences 23966) in 1 mL of PBS.
Adjust the pH to between 4 and 5 using 12 N HCl.
Sterilize the solution by passing it through a 0.22 µm filter unit.

steps.title: Seed 293 Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells into 15 cm dishes to reach target confluency.

substeps.instruction: Seed 2 × 10^7 293 cells in 15 cm dishes (split confluent 15 cm plates 1:2) to achieve ~70% to 80% confluency by the next morning.
Maintain cells in complete DMEM/10% FBS/1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic, using TrypLE for splitting before they reach confluency.
Ensure each plate contains 20 mL of culture medium.

steps.title: Perform Transfection
steps.instruction: Transfect the 293 cells using the prepared PEI and DNA mixtures.

substeps.instruction: For one 15 cm dish, prepare tube A in a 5 mL tube and tube B in a 50 mL tube.
Mix tube A and B by vortexing briefly for 5 seconds and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Add the mixture dropwise to the AAV293 cells (3 mL of transfection mixture per 150 mm dish) and swirl the medium to disperse evenly.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Incubation
steps.instruction: Maintain cells and change media post-transfection.

substeps.instruction: Between 12-24 hours post-transfection, change the medium to 15 mL of DMEM/1% FBS/1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic.
Incubate the cells until 72 hours post-transfection.

steps.title: Harvest Cells and Lyse
steps.instruction: Collect cells and perform freeze-thaw cycles to release AAV particles.

substeps.instruction: At 72 hours post-transfection, collect cells and medium from each plate using a cell scraper and transfer to a 50 mL tube.
Freeze the 50 mL tube in dry ice in an ice bucket.
Thaw the cell suspension at 37ºC.
Repeat the freeze/thaw cycle 3 more times (freeze for 20 minutes and thaw for 10 minutes each cycle).

steps.title: Nuclease Treatment and Clarification
steps.instruction: Degrade contaminating DNA and remove cell debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.6 µl Benzonase nuclease (~500U/150 mm plate) and incubate at 37ºC for 30 min.
Centrifuge the crude AAV suspension at 3,000 × g for 10 minutes.
Collect the supernatant into a clean 50 mL tube and discard the pellet.

steps.title: Concentrate AAV Lysate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the virus using centrifugal filtration.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the crude AAV lysate using an Amicon Ultra-15 centrifugal filter by centrifuging at 3,000 x g.
Check progress and discard flow-through as needed; continue centrifugation until the desired volume remains (ideally <150 µL).
Remove the virus from the Amicon filter and place into a clean Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Storage or Further Processing
steps.instruction: Store the resulting supernatant or proceed to purification.

substeps.instruction: Freeze the supernatant at -80ºC or purify directly.
